testcase.name: Scenario: Save a new modified part while closing it: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-document-saving-source/features/application/document-saving/document-saving.feature:127:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Save a new modified part while closing it ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/quick-access-toolbar/PartOne.opd` is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the user creates a new unsaved metric part ✔ And the user creates and finishes an empty sketch on the XY datum plane ✔ And the unsaved part containing that sketch is active ✔ And save-change prompts are configured to always show ✔ And another document is open ✔ And the proposed file name does not exist in the selected folder ✔ When the user closes the document tab ✔ And the user chooses Yes in the save-changes prompt ✔ And the user accepts the proposed file name in Save As ✔ Then the document closes ✔ And another open document becomes active ✔ When the user reopens the newly saved part in the same session ✔ Then the part becomes active ✔ And its model browser contains the finished sketch
